name: town10_rightrun
description: The showcase route asked for on 4 Nov (531 m, outer lane throughout): a1_test01's start in road 1's outer lane, straight through 468 (its light scripted red), right at 719 into road 18's kerb-side lane, straight through 189, right at 841 into road 9 (one lane each way: the stop-sign street), right again 11 m on at 134 into road 12, the goal 12 m short of its end (42 m of road 12 for parking).
source: Town10HD lane topology (tests/fixtures), right exits of the outer lane (4 Nov)
notes: Junctions by route s (entry-exit): 468 straight 151-193; 719 right 292-318; 189 straight 339-378; 841 right 433-455; 134 right 466-489. Legs between them: 193-292, 318-339 (21 m), 378-433, 455-466 (11 m), 489-531. Untested live: the inner-lane right at 719 failed 10/10 (its exit kerb ~2.6 m nearer the lane than the approach's); 841 and 134 are 11 m apart. No stop-sign behaviour and no parking are in the stack yet: the car drives the route and stops at the goal.
